items.title: Servo: fix manual D-pad up/down axis wiring (use tilt helpers) + fix Sentry tab switching so tracking/aiming state stays consistent (prevents 'autotracking no movement' from silent pause)
Tools: added non-blocking Pan/Tilt Range Check (Tools menu) with safe pause/restore and best-effort tilt movement confirmation
Fix: prevent pan/tilt direction desync (sync internal flip_* flags to invert_* UI/settings; persist invert_tilt changes)
Detection UI: Basic/Advanced toggle + mode-relevant visibility (AgentChangeID: DETECTION_UI_BASIC_ADVANCED_v1)
Docs: Hybrid Mode 4/5 thresholds + idle auto-resume/guard defaults + Sentry constants/persistence couplings
Docs: Added Sentry Mode integration section
Sentry Mode: added manual turret control
Fix: manual track crash (wrong method call)
Fix: false tilt-safety latch could suppress tilt on OK status messages

Fix: enforce yellow-dot-in-deadzone gating for automatic firing (Quick Strike + Rapid-fire + main lock loop + Sentry); unify Sentry safety with safety_state; prevent sticky pulse trigger when redundant-command skip occurs
Tooltips: centralized readable tooltip styles + mappings + audit list
